verdict.rationale: The firm's own pages describe it as a boutique immigration law firm offering attorney-led service since 1993. They state that all work is closely supervised by an attorney and reviewed by an attorney before submission, with attorneys supported by paralegals and legal writers. That is a clear attorney-supervision model, not an unsupervised form service. Missing for 10: individually named attorneys with bar admissions, an explicit attorney-of-record/filing statement (e.g., attorney signs and files the petition), independent corroboration of credentials.
